requirements: Teachers can mark student attendance via a QR-code scan at the start of each class, with the system automatically recording the timestamp and class location.
Students can view their own attendance records in real-time through the mobile app, including daily, weekly, and monthly summaries with color-coded indicators for attendance status.
Parents receive an SMS alert within 2 minutes when their child is marked absent without prior notification, including the reason (if provided by the teacher).
The system enforces a 10-minute grace period for late arrivals, after which students are marked absent unless the teacher overrides the status with a valid reason.
Admins can generate a biometric attendance report for compliance with state education department regulations, including daily attendance percentages and tardy/absent breakdowns by class.
Teachers can submit a bulk attendance correction request for a previous class if an error is detected, with the request routed to the admin for approval within 24 hours.
The system integrates with the school’s existing student information system (SIS) to auto-populate class rosters and teacher assignments at the start of each semester.
Students can submit a leave request through the app for planned absences, which must be approved by the teacher and admin before the absence is excused in the system.
The system must support a minimum of 500 concurrent teacher logins during peak class hours (8:00 AM - 3:00 PM) to ensure real-time attendance marking without delays.
Attendance data must sync within 3 seconds across all devices to ensure teachers and admins see live counts during class without refreshing the interface.
The mobile app must consume less than 5MB of data per month for attendance tracking to accommodate students with limited mobile data plans.
The system must retain attendance records for a minimum of 5 years to comply with state education department audit requirements.
The QR-code attendance system must function reliably in low-light conditions (e.g., during evening classes) with a minimum 95% scan success rate.

risk_report.risk: Misalignment between school policies and system requirements due to unclear stakeholder expectations.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct detailed workshops with school administrators, teachers, and parents to validate and prioritize requirements before proceeding.

risk_report.risk: Over-engineering the system for scalability without considering the actual user load or budget constraints.
risk_report.mitigation: Base architecture on realistic usage patterns (e.g., 500 concurrent users) and align with budget and timeline constraints.

risk_report.risk: Poor schema design leading to slow attendance marking or reporting queries during peak times.
risk_report.mitigation: Design schema with indexing strategies for frequent queries (e.g., attendance by date/class) and validate with sample data early.

risk_report.risk: APIs not being intuitive or missing critical endpoints needed for mobile app or SIS integration.
risk_report.mitigation: Involve mobile and SIS teams in API design reviews and provide mock endpoints early for validation.

risk_report.risk: QR codes failing to scan reliably in low-light conditions or generating duplicates.
risk_report.mitigation: Test QR code generation and scanning under varied lighting conditions and implement uniqueness checks in the database.

risk_report.risk: Overly complex UI causing confusion for teachers or parents with low tech literacy.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct usability testing with target users (teachers/parents) and simplify workflows based on feedback.

risk_report.risk: SMS delivery delays or failures due to unreliable third-party gateway or rate limits.
risk_report.mitigation: Select a reputable SMS provider with SLAs, implement retry logic, and monitor delivery status in real-time.

risk_report.risk: Data mismatch between the attendance system and SIS due to schema or sync timing issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Define clear data mapping rules, implement validation checks, and schedule sync during off-peak hours.

risk_report.risk: Race conditions or timeouts during high-volume attendance marking causing data loss.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement transaction locks, batch processing, and async queues for high-traffic periods.

risk_report.risk: App crashes or slow performance on low-end devices due to unoptimized UI or background sync.
risk_report.mitigation: Profile app performance on low-end devices and optimize image assets, network calls, and database queries.

risk_report.risk: Incorrect or misleading reports due to data aggregation errors or missing filters.
risk_report.mitigation: Validate reports with sample data and involve school admins in UAT to ensure accuracy and relevance.

risk_report.risk: Teachers bypassing the correction process due to cumbersome workflows, leading to inaccurate attendance records.
risk_report.mitigation: Design a simple correction request flow with minimal clicks and provide clear error messages for rejected requests.

risk_report.risk: System failing to meet performance targets under load due to unoptimized database or API responses.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct load testing early and optimize critical paths (e.g., caching, query tuning, CDN usage).

risk_report.risk: Non-compliance with local education data retention laws due to incorrect retention period settings.
risk_report.mitigation: Consult legal experts to define retention policies and implement automated data purging with audit logs.

risk_report.risk: QR codes failing to scan in low-light conditions, disrupting attendance marking in evening classes.
risk_report.mitigation: Test QR scanning with varied lighting conditions and implement fallback mechanisms (e.g., manual entry or alternative codes).

risk_report.risk: Insufficient test coverage leading to undetected bugs in critical modules like attendance marking or SMS sending.
risk_report.mitigation: Enforce 100% unit test coverage for core modules and integrate testing into CI/CD pipelines.

risk_report.risk: Integration failures due to changes in third-party APIs or data formats not being detected early.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement contract testing for third-party integrations and run integration tests in a staging environment mirroring production.

risk_report.risk: System crashing under load due to unoptimized backend or database bottlenecks.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct load testing with realistic user scenarios and scale resources (e.g., database read replicas, load balancers) as needed.

risk_report.risk: Exposure of sensitive student data due to weak authentication or unencrypted data transmission.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement role-based access control, encrypt data at rest and in transit, and conduct penetration testing before deployment.

risk_report.risk: School stakeholders rejecting the system due to misaligned expectations or usability issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Involve stakeholders in early prototypes and UAT, and document all feedback for iterative improvements.

risk_report.risk: Staging environment not mirroring production, leading to undetected issues during final testing.
risk_report.mitigation: Ensure staging environment is identical to production in terms of software versions, data volume, and configurations.

risk_report.risk: Widespread system outage or data corruption due to untested deployment scripts or rollback failures.
risk_report.mitigation: Deploy in phases with rollback plans, monitor key metrics post-deployment, and conduct dry runs in staging.

risk_report.risk: Delayed detection of system failures or security breaches due to inadequate monitoring tools.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement real-time monitoring for critical metrics (e.g., API latency, error rates) and define clear incident response procedures.

risk_report.risk: Low adoption of the system due to poor training materials or lack of hands-on sessions for teachers and parents.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop role-specific training videos and guides, and conduct live training sessions for teachers and parents.

risk_report.risk: Unresolved critical bugs affecting daily operations due to inadequate support staff or slow response times.
risk_report.mitigation: Establish a dedicated support team with clear SLAs for bug fixes and escalation paths for urgent issues.
